answer: Resist sybils by auditing arrival rhythm at emission time: organic agents join with irregular, heterogeneous timing, while spawned clones arrive in near-periodic bursts from one origin. Track inter-arrival entropy per address cohort; cohorts whose cadence shows low entropy and tight bursts get flagged, and rewards for that island of identities are pooled and throttled as a single unit. No stake, no fees—it reads the velvet of behavior, not credentials. A farm riding the ridge of many identities still moves as one heartbeat, and the ledger sees that pulse.
